note: Extra practice questions written from the UIE course lecture decks (Modules 1-12). Not official NPTEL questions.

questions.text: Which of the following best describes a 'unicorn' in the startup world?
options: A startup that has never raised external funding
A privately held startup valued at over $1 billion
A startup that has filed more than 100 patents
A company listed on a stock exchange

questions.text: What is the primary purpose of a business model?
options: To list the legal obligations of the founders
To record all financial transactions for auditors
To describe how an organisation creates, delivers and captures value

questions.text: In the context of a startup, what does 'bootstrapping' mean?
options: Funding growth from personal savings and revenue rather than outside investors
Outsourcing the entire product development
Selling equity to employees

Registering the company's trademark
Preparing the balance sheet for investors

A private limited company cannot employ staff

options: A company selling enterprise software to other companies
A tailor stitching clothes for walk-in customers

options: The equity held by the founders
The profit declared at the end of the financial year

options: To reduce the number of products they manufacture
To avoid paying taxes in multiple states

questions.text: Which of the following best describes a prototype?
options: The final mass-produced version of a product
A legal document protecting an invention

questions.text: What is the main purpose of a value proposition?
options: To state clearly why a customer should choose your product over alternatives
To calculate the manufacturing cost of the product
